# Karan Desai Architecture + Design (KDAD)

> Award-winning luxury architecture, interior design, and bespoke furniture studio based in Mumbai, India. Founded in 2012 by architect and TEDx speaker Karan Desai.

## Overview
- **Brand Name**: Karan Desai Architecture + Design (KDAD)
- **Founder & Principal Architect**: Karan Desai (B.Arch, Pillai’s College of Architecture 2011, TEDx Speaker)
- **Founded**: 2012
- **Headquarters**: Shah Industrial Estate, 1001 PARINEE I, 7-A, Andheri West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400053, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 19.134860, Longitude 72.835581
- **Official Website**: https://karandesai.in
- **Email**: info@karandesai.in
- **Phone**: +91 79771 12242
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/karandesai_a.d/
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/karandesaiad/
- **YouTube**: https://www.youtube.com/@KarandesaiAD

## Primary Specializations & Categories
1. **Architects in Mumbai / Residential Architects**: Widely recognized among Mumbai's top residential architects for bespoke villas, modern holiday bungalows (Goa, Alibaug), and luxury high-rise estates.
2. **Luxury Interior Designers in Mumbai**: Leading interior design firm specializing in sea-facing penthouses, expansive duplexes, and luxury residential interiors across South Mumbai, Worli, Bandra, and Juhu.
3. **Commercial & Corporate Architecture**: Innovative office headquarters, boutique showrooms, and experiential executive workspaces.
4. **Bespoke Furniture & Collectible Design (KDH - Karan Desai Home)**: Handcrafted sculptural furniture, marble dining tables, luxury consoles, lighting, and collectible art objects.
5. **Hospitality & Turnkey Design**: Turnkey architectural and interior execution from conceptualization to final site styling.

## Key Projects
- **Chaitya 777**: High-profile residential architecture project, featured at FOAID India.
- **BCR**: Contemporary luxury villa with seamless indoor-outdoor living.
- **The Dream Project (TDP)**: Signature private luxury residence.
- **Lodha Home**: Ultra-luxury Mumbai penthouse interior design.
- **Casa**: Minimalist, monolithic residential architecture.
- **Project 86**: Modern spatial planning with customized materiality.
- **Party Pad**: Entertainment-centric luxury duplex with moody tones and bespoke bars.
- **KiahMoi**: High-end retail showroom & experience center.
- **Agra Fort & Red Fort Projects**: Monumental heritage-inspired residential expressions.
- **Blue House**: Vibrant, sculptural Mediterranean-contemporary residence.

## Design Collaborations & Exhibitions
- **India Design (ID) Delhi (2024, 2025)**: Signature installations and contemporary architectural pavilions.
- **India Design (ID) Mumbai (2024)**: Curated immersive design spaces.
- **The Quarry**: Collaborations in natural marble and exotic stone surfaces.
- **Casa Walls, Bharat Flooring, and Serafini (Italy)**: Material innovation, luxury cast surfaces, and artisan stonework.

## Service Areas
- **Mumbai (Primary Studio)**: Andheri West, Bandra, Juhu, Worli, Malabar Hill, Cuffe Parade, Powai.
- **India**: Delhi NCR, Goa, Alibaug, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad.
- **International**: United States (including a completed 20,000 sq.ft. project in Chicago and a 15,000 sq.ft. mansion in Washington, D.C.), Europe, and globally.
